interpretation.detection_success: Sparse-sensor detection generalized strongly to the sealed L-Town cohort: 23 of 24 leaks alerted within five hours, with a one-hour median delay and no premature leak alerts.
interpretation.control_limitation: One of six no-leak controls alerted, so the control sample is too small to estimate nuisance behavior precisely.
interpretation.localization_failure: Pressure-search-zone localization is the limiting subsystem: only 47.8% of timely detections ranked the correct zone top-three and 60.9% top-five.
interpretation.search_reduction: A top-three recommendation retains 9.1% of the 33-zone search space, but the current conditional recall is not high enough for field confidence.
interpretation.diagnosis: The localizer had only 66 labeled development leaks for 33 zone classes (two examples per zone across train plus validation). This is severe sample starvation relative to the topology.
interpretation.next_iteration: Keep the detection formulation stable; generate a denser zone-balanced localization corpus with multiple leak pipes, diameters, and start times per zone, then evaluate on a fresh sealed L-Town cohort.
